description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). When the engineer asks to open or edit a draft, or one of their published posts, in the browser: a link to the browser editor that works once and expires in 15 minutes. Show it to them as a link and say so; never open or fetch it yourself. id is one of their drafts; post (or a published draft's id) opens or finds the post's revision, as revise_post does. Only their own drafts and posts (the site owner: any). The editor link in their email is unchanged.

id.description: One of your drafts (list_drafts lists them). A published one opens its revision.

post.description: Instead of id: one of your published posts, its URL or slug. Opens (or finds) its revision.

name: open_editor

editor_url.description: Opens the browser editor once, within 15 minutes. Null while the preview is still being built

id.description: The draft the editor opens on: for a published post, its revision

revision_opened.description: True when this call opened the revision

title: Open in the browser editor
